faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) for hiring eligible candidates on a contractual basis in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under IIFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Consultant (Accounts) under Advt./ NT/ Con. / Del./ 14 / 2026, offering professional contractual opportunities in the education sector.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Consultant (Accounts)?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Accounts) position at the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a CA, CMA, or MBA (Finance) degree along with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in a recognized institution or organization.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 35 years and the maximum age limit is 62 years for candidates applying for this position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging from Rs. 1,00,000/- to Rs. 1,30,000/- depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 07-10-2026. Applicants should complete their submissions well ahead of time.

faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly online. Candidates need to submit their forms via the designated online recruitment portal.

faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications followed by a test or interview to evaluate the suitability of candidates.
